draft.emotion: warm and light, expressing a genuine sense of contentment and well-being
notes: Can be used with both 'ser' (to be a happy person, or to describe a happy time) and 'estar' (to feel happy right now).
Like all Spanish words ending in '-z', the 'z' changes to 'c' in the plural: 'felices'.
